```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(targets)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))
targets::tar_load(qc_params)
targets::tar_load(metadata_flagged_all)
targets::tar_load(mt_genes)
targets::tar_load(rp_genes)
targets::tar_load(hb_genes)

df         <- metadata_flagged_all
df_margins <- df %>% mutate(sample.name = "All")
df_plot    <- bind_rows(df, df_margins)

clust_col <- "sNN_pca.SCT_20_res.0.1"

tar_load(annotation_config)
ct <- annotation_config$cell_types
ct_markers <- lapply(ct, \(x) as.character(x$markers))
cell_type_labels <- setNames(
  rep(names(ct_markers), lengths(ct_markers)),
  unlist(ct_markers)
)
```

# QC

## Cells retained after QC filtering

```{r before-after-barplot}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
df |>
  dplyr::mutate(status = ifelse(pass_cell, "Clean", "Removed")) |>
  dplyr::count(compartment, sample.name, status) |>
  dplyr::mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("Clean", "Removed"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = sample.name, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Clean" = "#2166ac", "Removed" = "#d6604d"), name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~compartment, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of cells") +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text    = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.position = "top")
```

## Per-compartment QC thresholds

Global: mitochondrial % ≤ `r qc_params$mito_percent_max`%, haemoglobin % ≤ `r qc_params$hb_percent_max`%.

```{r cutoff-table}
compartment_qc <- qc_params$compartment_qc
cutoff_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(compartment_qc), function(comp) {
  x <- compartment_qc[[comp]]
  data.frame(Compartment = comp,
             nFeature_min = x$nFeature_min, nFeature_max = x$nFeature_max,
             ribo_pct_min = x$ribo_percent_min, ribo_pct_max = x$ribo_percent_max,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
knitr::kable(cutoff_df,
             col.names = c("Compartment", "nFeature min", "nFeature max",
                           "Ribo % min", "Ribo % max"),
             align = "lrrrr")
```

## QC filter co-occurrence {.smaller}

```{r qc-cooccurrence-heatmap}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 5
qc_flags   <- c("pass_mt", "pass_nFeature", "pass_rp", "pass_hb", "pass_hto", "pass_dbl")
nice_names <- c(pass_mt = "Mito %", pass_nFeature = "nFeature",
                pass_rp = "Ribo %",  pass_hb = "Hb %",
                pass_hto = "HTO",    pass_dbl = "Doublet")

cooc_per_compartment <- function(md) {
  flag_mat <- as.matrix(md[, qc_flags])
  n        <- length(qc_flags)
  cooc     <- matrix(0L, n, n, dimnames = list(qc_flags, qc_flags))
  for (i in seq_len(n))
    for (j in seq_len(n))
      cooc[i, j] <- sum(!flag_mat[, i] & !flag_mat[, j])
  long <- reshape2::melt(cooc, varnames = c("metric_x", "metric_y"), value.name = "n_cells")
  long$metric_x <- factor(nice_names[as.character(long$metric_x)], levels = nice_names)
  long$metric_y <- factor(nice_names[as.character(long$metric_y)], levels = rev(nice_names))
  long
}

cooc_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(split(df, df$compartment), cooc_per_compartment),
  .id = "compartment"
)

ggplot(cooc_long, aes(metric_x, metric_y, fill = n_cells)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_cells,
                colour = n_cells > max(n_cells) * 0.5), size = 3.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white", "FALSE" = "grey20"), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f7fbff", high = "#08519c",
                      name = "Cells failing\nboth metrics") +
  facet_wrap(~compartment, nrow = 1) +
  labs(title = "Co-occurrence of QC filter failures per compartment", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text    = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.position = "right")
```

# Canonical markers

## HSC

```{r bubble-hsc}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 8
marker_genes_hsc <- unlist(ct_markers)
marker_genes_hsc <- marker_genes_hsc[marker_genes_hsc %in% rownames(mpn_processed_hsc)]
cell_type_labels_hsc <- cell_type_labels[marker_genes_hsc]

p_umap_hsc <- lean_dimplot(
  Seurat::DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc, group.by = clust_col, reduction = "umap.nn"),
  colour_col = clust_col, legend_title = "Cluster",
  label = TRUE, label_size = 4
) + theme(legend.position = "none")

p_dot_hsc <- Seurat::DotPlot(mpn_processed_hsc, features = marker_genes_hsc,
                              group.by = clust_col,
                              cols = c("lightgrey", "#2166ac"), dot.scale = 4) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(names(cell_type_labels_hsc), marker_genes_hsc)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cluster", title = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        plot.margin = margin(l = 5))

p_umap_hsc + p_dot_hsc + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2.5))
```

# Markers — WT vs HET+/HET−

## HSC — top DE genes {.smaller}

```{r markers-hsc}
tar_load(delegate_samples_markers_hsc)
diff_tbl_sig_hsc <- delegate_samples_markers_hsc %>%
  filter(padj <= 0.001, abs(log_fc) >= 0.25)

diff_tbl_sig_hsc %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster, group1) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(abs(log_fc), n = 5) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(log_fc = round(log_fc, 3), padj = signif(padj, 3)) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

## HSC — sex genes drive top hits

```{r sex-genes-hsc}
#| fig-width: 14

                      split.by = "sample.name")
rm(mpn_processed_hsc); gc()
```
